claim: Costco's diluted EPS down 17% from the prior year in fiscal 2024
summary: Costco's diluted EPS did not fall 17% in fiscal 2024; based on model knowledge it rose about 17% year-over-year (approximately $16.56 vs $14.16 in fiscal 2023), the opposite direction of the claim.
